$comment: Previously https://torus.dev/schemas/data-link.schema.json. Renamespaced 2026-09-01 to the canonical torusai.io namespace. Nothing resolves schemas by $id — every validator loads by file path — so the change is declarative. Enforced by torus-multibuild lib/namespace.mjs.
title: Library ↔ Data link
description: A one-directional, optional link from a Library record to quantitative evidence held elsewhere. The Library validates the SHAPE of a reference; it does not define the measurement system's internal identifier grammar, because that belongs to the measurement system.

contract_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this contract. A consumer must refuse an unknown MAJOR and may accept an unknown MINOR (forward-compatible).

library_id.description: The Library record being cited. The Library is authoritative for this identifier.

library_status_at_link.description: The record's status when the link was made. Recorded so a later status change is visible as history rather than silently rewriting the link's meaning.

data_ref.description: A namespaced reference: '<source>:<identifier>'. The source names the measurement system; the identifier is OPAQUE to the Library and is validated only for non-emptiness. This is deliberate — defining the identifier grammar would mean inventing a product the Library does not own.

relation.description: measures: the observation quantifies what the record describes. supports: the observation is evidence for a claim the record makes. relates_to: a weaker association.

observed_at.description: Instant of observation, when a single instant applies.

provenance.description: How the observation was produced, in prose.

fingerprint.description: Optional SHA-256 supplied by the measurement system, identifying the exact observation referenced. The Library stores it; it does not compute or verify it, because it does not hold the observation.
